name: simpro
description: Simpro job management — quotes, jobs, customers and invoices for field-service and trade contractors. Quotes originate from Ground Plan estimating software.

connection.instructions: Click Connect, then enter your Simpro Build URL (e.g. yourbuild.simprosuite.com) when prompted. You'll be redirected to Simpro to authorize, then asked to choose a company if your Build has more than one.
